messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

I'm free from 09:00 to 14:05. I can spend at most S$89. I want to visit Singapore Cable Car. Optionally, Maxwell Food Centre, National Gallery Singapore, Singapore River Cruise, Jewel Changi Airport Rain Vortex, River Wonders and Night Safari. I want to do Maxwell Food Centre before Singapore Cable Car. I want to be at Maxwell Food Centre no earlier than 08:30 and done there by 10:45.

response: Hey, I’ve got some free time from 09:00 to 14:05 and a budget of S$89. I’m definitely looking to check out Singapore Cable Car, but I need to make sure I hit Maxwell Food Centre before that. Just a heads up, I need to be at Maxwell Food Centre no earlier than 08:30 and finished up by 10:45. If there's extra time, I'd love to squeeze in National Gallery Singapore, Singapore River Cruise, Jewel Changi Airport Rain Vortex, River Wonders, or Night Safari too!
